title: brief
description: The start of a session. The session knows only its brief.

title.description: A short title that names all of the scope.

goal.description: What the session must make, and why. Steps go here too.

scope.description: What is in scope and what is not.

doneWhen.description: The check that shows that the work is done.

skills.description: The plugin skills to load first.

agent.description: The agent role, for example worker.

cwd.description: The working folder. Default: the folder of the parent.

worktree.description: true: the supervisor makes a git worktree for this session.

parent.description: The full id of the parent session.

allowDefaults.description: true: a merge may carry default decisions that the user did not approve. Only the user sets it. Child sessions get it from their parent.
